pain_point: Shift workers need to know exactly what time they're working on any given day across rotating schedules, but existing schedules are just static PDFs or spreadsheets that don't tell you 'what time do I start tomorrow?' at a glance
target_user: Healthcare shift workers (RNs, CNAs, techs) on 3x12 or 4x12 rotations, plus first responders on 24/48 rotations
visual_style: Hospital Wall Bulletin — clinical beige background (#F4F2EA), institutional blue header (#2A5C8A), color-coded shift blocks (day=amber #F5C842, evening=indigo #4A6FA5, night=deep purple #5B4D63), analog clock countdown timer showing 'Time until next shift' in real-time, bold sans-serif times, weekly grid with current day highlighted, shift pattern preview text ('Mon/Wed/Fri 7A-7P'), clean institutional grid with blue separator lines, maximum clarity minimum decoration
tech_stack: React + TypeScript + Vite, served via nginx in Docker
